evidence_sentence: The function checks for the presence of required endpoints, allocates memory for the private data structure, initializes locks and FIFO buffers, and configures packet format based on the interrupt output size.
rationale: The fixed implementation adds an initial guard that verifies both interrupt endpoint URBs are present and returns -ENODEV if either is missing. The vulnerable implementation has no such endpoint-presence check and dereferences the URB pointers later when deriving default intervals. The cited Logic sentence explicitly describes this fixed-only check; its remaining operations are common to both versions.
rewritten_docstring: The function allocates memory for the private data structure, initializes locks and FIFO buffers, and configures packet format based on the interrupt output size. It also handles special cases for certain devices and sets the read/write intervals based on provided values or defaults. Finally, it associates the private data with the port and sets a drain delay before returning the success status.
